newsitem.title: UK: Libya cuts April Es Sider crude by 35 cents - trade.
newsitem.headline: Libya cuts April Es Sider crude by 35 cents - trade.

text.p: Libya has cut the oil export price formula of its key Es Sider crude by 35 cents a barrel for April loadings and reduced them for most other grades by between 10 and 30 cents, traders said on Wednesday.
Libya told customers Es Sider would sell for Dated Brent -40 cents in April, down from Dated Brent -5 cents in March.
Sirtica crude was cut by 30 cents to Dated Brent -25 cents, while Brega and Zueitina were both cut by 25 cents to Dated Brent +15 cents.
Sarir and Amna were cut by 20 cents to Dated Brent -75 cents and Dated Brent -80 cents respectively while Bu Attifel was reduced by 10 cents to Dated Brent -40 cents.
Only Bouri was left unchanged at Iranian Heavy quotes less 35 cents a barrel, traders said.
